Initial release — Amazon FBA Calculator skill.

- Calculates net profit, margin, ROI, and break-even ACoS for Amazon FBA products
- Accepts product price, COGS, category, dimensions, weight, ad spend, and other costs
- Outputs full P&L breakdown, key metrics, risk flags, sensitivity analysis, and tips
- Includes latest Amazon FBA and referral fee structures for 2024–2025
- Supports quick, interactive, and comparative calculations; lets you save product profiles
- No API keys required; works from simple descriptions or exact numbers
